experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0. Full collisions: 0. Observation coW6 (and w7_w6_pairs) per 150 first blocks; if the four variants passed F6 independently (each with probability 2^-3.90) about 150 x 0.0245 = 3.7 first blocks per trial would have two or more passes. The four variants of one class share most of their bits, so a clearly higher count is expected (about 3.4 times that in our local replays); it measures the within-class correlation of the W6 filter, which the ledger does not need (it uses only expectations), and is not a test of success events.
